next.NO_SERIAL_PORT: Plug in the flight controller or the telemetry radio, then connect again.

connect.open: Connect to a vehicle, or see the link

next.tcp: Check that the vehicle listens on this address and that nothing else is using it, then connect again.
next.serial: Check the cable, that no other program has the port open, and the baud rate, then connect again.
next.simulator: Close the dialog and try again; if it keeps failing, restart the application.

tuning.reboot: {id} takes effect only after a restart: not written while the vehicle is armed.

staged.armedSetup: Setup changes are not written while the vehicle is armed, or may be. Disarm it first.
staged.armedLogging: Logging settings are not written while the vehicle is armed, or may be. Disarm it first.

staged.allWritten: {count} written and read back. | All {count} written and read back.
staged.alreadyMatch: {count} queued reset already matches the vehicle. | {count} queued resets already match the vehicle.
staged.leftOut: {count} left out: the vehicle already had its value when you confirmed. | {count} left out: the vehicle already had their values when you confirmed.

housekeeping.blocked: This setting cannot be changed while the vehicle is armed (or its state is not known) or a download is running: it was put back to what it was. Change it again when they are over.

autoDownload.failed: Log {id} was not downloaded after landing: {why}. It is not tried again by itself.
autoDownload.notSettled: The newest log was still growing after a minute, so nothing was downloaded after landing.

settings.fixed: Fixed: it is matched by the character it types, so it cannot be changed.
settings.press: Press the new key for “{action}”. Escape gives up.

why.reserved: That key belongs to the system or the browser (reload, close, copy…). Choose another.

load.label: Load parameter metadata…
load.keywords: metadata descriptions apm.pdef pdef file open

stop.label: Emergency stop
stop.title: Emergency stop
stop.what: The motors stop NOW, wherever the vehicle is. A flying vehicle will crash. Use it only when something is wrong and the vehicle is a danger.

arm.label: Arm the vehicle
arm.title: Arm the vehicle
arm.what: The motors will be able to spin. The vehicle runs its own pre-arm checks and refuses if one fails: its reasons are shown. Check that the propellers are clear and the area is safe.

takeoff.label: Take off
takeoff.keywords: launch climb lift off fly up

disarm.label: Disarm the vehicle
disarm.title: Disarm the vehicle
disarm.what: The motors stop and cannot spin. A vehicle that is flying refuses a disarm.

mode.title: Change the flight mode to {mode}
mode.what: Changes the flight mode of the armed vehicle to {mode}. Its behaviour changes at once.
mode.whatAuto: AUTO starts the mission on the armed vehicle. Its behaviour changes at once.

reboot.unsupported: {vehicle} does not support a reboot from here.
reboot.noAnswer: No answer from {vehicle}. If it is rebooting, the link comes back by itself. If nothing happens, try again.
reboot.label: Reboot flight controller
reboot.title: Reboot flight controller
reboot.what: Restarts the flight controller. The link drops for a few seconds and comes back by itself. Parameters are not changed. Only while disarmed.

initial.summary: Starting values calculated by Mission Planner's Initial Parameter Setup for a multicopter, from the size of its propellers and the kind and cells of its battery. They are suggestions: choose them, look at the list on the side, and write them.
initial.cellsHelp: A whole number from 1 to {max}. The voltages are of one cell: {full} V full, {empty} V empty.
initial.source: Formulas of Mission Planner's Config > Initial Parameter Setup (ConfigInitialParams.cs). Not taken from it: its T-Motor and "Suggested" boxes. The acceleration limits are written in the unit the vehicle uses. MOT_THST_HOVER 0.2 replaces a hover value the vehicle has learned: leave it out after a flight. MOT_THST_EXPO is best measured on a thrust stand.

why.aboveRange: the vehicle's value is above this parameter's range (another unit?): not offered
why.range: the calculated value is outside this parameter's range: not offered

initial.sizeHelp: A number from {min} to {max}, with one decimal at most, e.g. 9 or 10.5.
initial.after: After a test flight (landed and disarmed), Mission Planner advises: set ATC_THR_MIX_MAN to 0.5, and set PSC_D_ACC_P to 0.1 × MOT_THST_HOVER and PSC_D_ACC_I to 0.2 × MOT_THST_HOVER (older firmware: PSC_ACCZ_P to MOT_THST_HOVER and PSC_ACCZ_I to 2 × MOT_THST_HOVER).

state.unknown: Cannot be told from the parameters

setup.revert: Put back what the vehicle has

blocked.loading: The parameters are still being read.
blocked.armed: The vehicle is armed. Setup changes are not written until it is disarmed.
blocked.unknown: It is not known whether the vehicle is disarmed (no recent heartbeat), so nothing is written.

offline.title: No vehicle is connected
offline.help: Connect a vehicle to set it up.

kind.title: Setup is not available yet for this kind of vehicle
kind.help: The setup pages are built for multicopters first. This vehicle says it is a {type}.

home.heading: Setup
home.summary: What the parameters say of each step. It is read from them, not checked in flight: each card says what it looked at.
home.allSet: Every step that can be read from the parameters looks set up.

status.notOnVehicle: These parameters are not on this vehicle

accel.checked: INS_ACCOFFS are all zero and INS_ACCSCAL all one: not set

compass.checked: COMPASS_OFS are all zero: not set

radio.checked: RC1 to RC4 MIN and MAX are all 1100 and 1900: the defaults

motors.checked: The motor test is not run from here yet

modes.checked: FLTMODE1 to FLTMODE6 include RTL, Land or SmartRTL

frame.title: Frame and orientation are not built yet
frame.help: They will set FRAME_CLASS, FRAME_TYPE and the board orientation, with a drawing and a reboot prompt. Use Parameters meanwhile.

accel.title: The accelerometer calibration is not built yet

compass.title: The compass calibration is not built yet

radio.title: The radio page is not built yet
radio.help: It will show the channels live and calibrate their range.

motors.title: Motors and ESCs are not built yet
motors.help: The motor test has its own release, with its own safety review.

battery.title: The battery page is not built yet
battery.help: It will set the monitor, capacity and thresholds, and calibrate voltage and current.

serial.title: Serial ports are not built yet
serial.help: It will set each port's protocol and speed.

devices.title: Devices are not built yet
devices.help: It will decode each sensor's bus and address.

modes.summary: Each slot is a position of the mode switch on your transmitter. Choose what the vehicle does in each.
modes.loading: Reading the modes of this vehicle…
modes.channel: Channel of the mode switch (0 is none)
modes.noLive: The position the switch is in now is not shown here yet.
modes.noEscape: No switch position can bring the vehicle home or down. Assign RTL, Land or SmartRTL to one of them.
modes.good1: Start with a mode that holds position.
modes.good2: Keep a return or land mode on one easy flick.
modes.good3: Put Auto far from the position you take off in.

hint.4: Follows commands from the ground station
hint.18: Throw it into the air to start

action.landIfPosition: Land, in a mode that needs a position
action.autoLandOrRtl: Land start point, or return home

does.nothing: it keeps flying and only warns you
does.disabled: the failsafe is off: the vehicle does not react
does.landIfPosition: it lands in a mode that needs a position (in Stabilize or AltHold it does nothing)
does.smartRtlOrRtl: it retraces its path, then returns home
does.smartRtlOrLand: it retraces its path, then lands
does.terminate: it stops the motors and falls
does.autoLandOrRtl: it goes to the landing start point of the mission, or returns home
does.brakeOrLand: it brakes, or lands if it cannot
does.altHold: in a mode that needs a position it holds altitude and hands you control

failsafes.summary: What the vehicle does on its own when something goes wrong. Nothing is written until you write, and never while it is armed.
failsafes.order: The critical voltage must be below the low voltage.
failsafes.noName: it does action {value}, which has no name here

if.gcs: If the ground station is lost for 5 s, {does}.
if.ekf: If the position estimate can no longer be trusted, {does}.

warn.nothing: This failsafe does nothing: the vehicle goes on and only warns you.
warn.disabled: This failsafe is off: when it happens the vehicle does not react at all.
warn.terminate: This failsafe stops the motors in the air: the vehicle falls.

info.summary: What the board says of itself and of its sensors. A value the vehicle did not give is not shown.
info.noSensors: The vehicle has not sent its sensor status yet.

reboot.needed: Reboot needed: what was written takes effect when the flight controller restarts.

battery.summary: Accurate voltage and capacity are what make the failsafes and the flight-time estimates trustworthy.
battery.noLiveSecond: The vehicle's live voltage and current are of the first battery. The second has its monitor and capacity here, and no calibration.
battery.noReading: The vehicle shows no reading yet, so there is nothing to calibrate against.
battery.secondLook: That is more than 15% from what the vehicle shows. Check the reading.
battery.checked: I read the meter again and it is right
battery.thresholds: The low and critical voltages and what the vehicle does at them are under Failsafes.

voltage.title: Calibrate the voltage
voltage.help: Measure the battery with a multimeter and type the reading. The new multiplier is the old one times the meter over what the vehicle shows.

current.title: Calibrate the current
current.help: Measure the current with a clamp meter under load and type the reading. The new amps per volt is the old one times the meter over what the vehicle shows.

battery.noMultiplier: This monitor does not use a voltage multiplier, so there is nothing to calibrate here.
battery.offsetNote: This works out the multiplier only: an offset the sensor has is left as it is.
battery.sameValue: That is the value the vehicle has already: there is nothing to change.

frame.summary: How many motors the vehicle has and how they are mixed, and how the board sits in it.
frame.warning: A wrong frame makes the vehicle uncontrollable. Change it only while the vehicle is disarmed, with the propellers off, and check the motor order before you fly.
frame.takesEffect: Changes take effect at the next boot. After changing the board orientation, level the vehicle again.
frame.noDrawing: There is no drawing for this frame.
frame.drawingKey: Front is up. The number is the motor's number in the motor test, not the output it is wired to; the arrow is the way it spins.

serial.summary: What each serial port of the board is used for, and how fast it talks.
serial.mayCut: A change to Serial {ports} may cut the connection this app talks over: it carries MAVLink, or may be the port a ground station uses.
serial.none: This vehicle has no serial port parameters.
serial.willCut: After the reboot the connection over Serial {ports} will be lost if this app talks over it: it carried MAVLink, or may be the port a ground station uses.

devices.summary: The sensors the vehicle has seen, with the id it keeps for each decoded into the bus, the address and the device type.
devices.none: The vehicle has none of the parameters that hold device ids.
devices.typeHelp: The device type is a number that only means something for that kind of sensor, so it is shown as the number.

escs.summary: How the ESCs are driven and the thresholds the motors spin at.

motors.summary: What the vehicle’s outputs are doing now, and a test of each motor.
motors.protocolHelp: The protocol of the motor outputs (MOT_PWM_TYPE). It takes effect after a reboot, and the ESCs must understand it.
motors.MOT_SPIN_ARMHelp: The part of the throttle range the motors turn at when armed and idle (MOT_SPIN_ARM), from 0 to 0.2. Below the lowest spin in flight.
motors.MOT_SPIN_MINHelp: The lowest part of the throttle range the motors are driven at in flight (MOT_SPIN_MIN), from 0 to 0.25.
motors.MOT_SPIN_MAXHelp: The highest part of the throttle range the motors are driven at (MOT_SPIN_MAX), from 0.9 to 1.
motors.order: The thresholds must not fall: spin when armed at most the lowest spin in flight, and that at most the highest spin. Nothing is written until they are in that order.
motors.noOutputsHelp: They appear when the vehicle reports them.
motors.range: Out of range: what is typed is not written.
motors.outputsOld: The vehicle has stopped reporting its outputs.
motors.outputsOldHelp: The last pulses are not shown: they would look current. They appear again when the vehicle reports them.
motors.protocolUnknown: This vehicle does not report its ESC protocol.

test.title: Motor test
test.warning: TAKE THE PROPELLERS OFF first. A motor spins while its button is held, at the throttle below (20 % at most), and stops when you let go, when this window loses the focus, when you leave the page, or when anything goes wrong.
test.help: Hold a button to spin that motor (Space or Enter holds it from the keyboard). The letters are the order the vehicle tests its motors in, A first; the drawing is the frame, the front is up.
test.frame: The vehicle fixes the order of its motors when it starts. The frame was changed since it started, or the app cannot tell whether it has restarted since: the letters may not be the motors that turn. Restart the vehicle from this app (the command Reboot flight controller) to test a motor.
test.noLayout: This page has no drawing for this frame, so it cannot say which motor is which: the motor test is not offered.
test.offline: Connect a vehicle to test a motor.
test.unknown: The vehicle's armed state is not known (no recent heartbeat): no motor can be tested.
test.armed: The vehicle is armed: disarm it to test a motor.
test.running: Motor {letter} is running. Let go of the button to stop it.

stopped.SILENT: This page stopped saying it holds the button: motor {letter} was stopped.
stopped.LINK_LOST: The link to the vehicle was lost: motor {letter} was told to stop, and stops by itself within 1.5 s.
stopped.REFUSED: The vehicle did not accept the test of motor {letter} (its own message is in the messages).
stopped.UNACKNOWLEDGED: The vehicle did not answer the test of motor {letter}: a stop was sent.
stopped.ARMED: The vehicle is armed: the test of motor {letter} did not begin.
stopped.STATE_UNKNOWN: The vehicle's armed state is not known: the test of motor {letter} did not begin.
stopped.BUSY: The vehicle is busy (another test, a calibration, a parameter or log operation, or a reboot): the test of motor {letter} did not begin.
stopped.NOT_CONNECTED: No vehicle is connected: the test of motor {letter} did not begin.

radio.summary: Move every stick and switch of the transmitter: its bar moves with it. To calibrate, start, move each stick to all its ends and each switch to all its positions, put the sticks back in the middle (the throttle low), and press Done. Nothing is written until you write it.
radio.running: Calibrating: move every stick and switch through its whole range, centre the sticks, then press Done.
radio.noChannelsHelp: Switch the transmitter on, and check that the receiver is connected to the vehicle.
radio.glitches: Readings outside 800–2200 µs are not readings and were ignored: {count}.
radio.staged: Values chosen from this calibration: {count} (the range of each channel that moved, the trim of roll, pitch and yaw). Write them with “Write and verify”.
radio.nothingMoved: No channel moved enough to give a range: nothing was chosen.
radio.offCentre: No trim was chosen for channel {channels}: its stick was not in the middle when you pressed Done. Centre it and calibrate again to set the trim.
radio.auxHelp: What each auxiliary channel does when its switch is moved (RCn_OPTION). The names come from the parameter metadata: load it on the Parameters page to see them; without it the number is shown.

blocked.armed: The vehicle is armed. Disarm it to calibrate.
blocked.unknown: The vehicle's armed state is not known (no recent heartbeat), so it counts as armed. Calibration waits.

error.ARMED: The vehicle is armed: disarm it to calibrate.
error.STATE_UNKNOWN: The vehicle's state is not known (no heartbeat for 3 s): nothing was started.
error.BUSY: Something else is running (a calibration, a parameter or log transfer, or a reboot): try again when it is done.
error.NOT_ASKED: The vehicle is not asking for that position (yet).
error.NOT_RUNNING: No calibration is running for that.
error.NOT_ACCEPTED: The vehicle did not accept the results: did any compass succeed?
error.NO_READINGS: No radio reading has been taken yet: move the sticks and switches first.

code.LINK_LOST: the link to the vehicle was lost
code.NOT_UP: the vehicle did not say it is up: wait a moment and try again

calibration.unsure: The vehicle may still be calibrating, or may have kept the results: check the values before you trust them; if it keeps calibrating, restart it.

accel.summary: Place the vehicle in six positions, one after the other. The vehicle asks for each; press Placed when it is in that position and still. Keep it still from the start: the gyros are calibrated first.
accel.cancelNote: Cancelling stops the page waiting; the vehicle keeps its calibration open until it ends or it restarts, and the next start goes on from there.
accel.changesNote: Written by the vehicle when it accepts the calibration, never by this page.
accel.trimNote: Both the full calibration (when INS_TRIM_OPTION is 1, the default) and “Level only” set the trim:
accel.starting: Waiting for the vehicle, then calibrating the gyros: keep the vehicle still.
accel.waiting: Waiting for the vehicle to ask for a position.
accel.place: Place the vehicle {where}, keep it still, then press Placed.
accel.holding: Holding still: the vehicle is taking the sample.

compass.summary: Turn the vehicle round, every way, away from metal and cables, while the vehicle says how far each compass is. Nothing is kept until you accept.
compass.autosave: Let the vehicle keep the result by itself
compass.autosaveHelp: Off: the results wait for your Accept.
compass.running: Turn the vehicle round, every way, until every compass is complete.
compass.review: Every compass has reported. Check the results, then accept the ones you want to keep, or discard them.
compass.sphere: {lit} of {all} sections of the sphere have samples
compass.turnedKept: The vehicle found this compass turned. Accepting keeps the new orientation (COMPASS_AUTO_ROT is 2 or more).
compass.turnedNotKept: The vehicle found this compass turned. The orientation is not changed (COMPASS_AUTO_ROT is below 2).
compass.acceptHelp: Accepting keeps the offsets, diagonals, off-diagonals and scale, replacing the old ones (the parameter review keeps them for a revert). The new values are used after a reboot.
compass.kept: The results were kept. The old offsets are replaced; the parameter review keeps them for a revert.
compass.orderHelp: The compass in place 1 is the one the vehicle uses first. Changes are written with the button on the right, and used after a reboot.

tune.armedAnnounce: The vehicle is armed: changes apply in flight.
tune.link: Link roll and pitch: one slider sets both
tune.differ: Roll and pitch differ on the vehicle: they are not linked, so that one does not overwrite the other. Link them to set both.

chart.title: Live response
chart.stale: Old data: nothing has come for a while
chart.noStep: No step in the last {seconds} seconds: nothing is measured.
chart.oldStep: Old data: the last step is not shown as if it were current.
chart.step: Measured of the latest step of the desired rate: {from} to {to} degrees a second.
chart.noActual: The vehicle did not take the request for the actual rate (ATTITUDE): it is not shown.
chart.noDesired: The vehicle did not take the request for the desired rate (ATTITUDE_TARGET): it is not shown, and nothing is measured.

analyse.summary: Measures how the vehicle followed the turn rate it asked for in a flight log on this computer: the biggest steps of the desired rate, with the overshoot, the rise and the settling, like the live response. Nothing is written to the vehicle.
analyse.tlog: Not available for a recording (.tlog): only a flight log from the vehicle holds the rate messages.
analyse.noLogs: No flight log on this computer. Download one from the vehicle (Logs: On the vehicle) or import one (Logs: Flights).
analyse.steps: Steps found in the log, the largest first
analyse.slow: RATE was logged at about {rate} times a second here (below {minimum}): a fast step is seen with few points, and its rise and settling are rough.
analyse.chartTitle: {axis} rate in the log, degrees a second
analyse.gap: The log has a hole of {ms} ms in the actual rate inside this step (a dropped block or a card that stalled): the overshoot, rise and settling are not measured, because a line across the hole would be a number nobody measured.

idle.title: Nothing analysed yet
idle.help: The newest log is chosen: press Analyse to read it, or choose another.

noRate.title: This log has no RATE messages
noRate.help: The vehicle logs them only when LOG_BITMASK has "Fast Attitude" (ATTITUDE_FAST, bit 0) or "Medium Attitude" (ATTITUDE_MED, bit 1) set. Set one, fly, and download that log.

noStep.title: No suitable step in this log
noStep.help: The desired rate never jumped by a step that then held (at least 20 degrees a second). Fly a quick roll, pitch or yaw and analyse that log.

rate.summary: How hard the vehicle corrects a turn rate it is not at: P by how far off it is, I by how long it has been off, D by how fast it is closing in, FF by what the stick asks for. Each slider is held to the range ArduPilot gives for it.

more.summary: The attitude controller, how the sticks feel, the position controller and what the radio knob tunes. Each slider is held to the range ArduPilot gives for it.

tune.notNumber: That is not a number: nothing is written for it.

refused.negative: Negative: refused here and by the backend. It is not written.
refused.above: Above the most ArduPilot's table allows ({max}): refused here and by the backend. It is not written.
refused.below: Below the least of ArduPilot's table ({min}) while the vehicle is armed: refused here and by the backend. It is not written.
refused.nan: Not a number: it is not written.
refused.reboot: Takes effect only after a restart: it is not written while the vehicle is armed (refused here and by the backend).

tune.hoverLearning: While learning is on, the vehicle changes this value itself: a number written here is not kept. Set learning to Disabled first if you mean it to stay.
tune.axesNote: Set before AutoTune is engaged: changing it while AutoTune runs changes which axes it goes on to.

filters.summary: The gyro filter and the first harmonic notch. The gyro cutoff and the notch's centre, bandwidth and attenuation take effect in flight. The notch's switch, tracking mode, reference, harmonics and options are read only when the vehicle starts: they are written while the vehicle is disarmed, and take effect after a restart.
filters.armed: Armed: only the gyro cutoff and the notch's centre, bandwidth and attenuation can be changed, and they apply in flight. The rest take effect only after a restart and are written while disarmed.
filters.afterRestart: Takes effect only after a restart of the vehicle.
filters.tracking: This notch tracks the throttle, a sensor or the FFT, so its centre moves: the page does not check it against the peaks of the log that is open in Spectrum.
filters.misses: The notch as chosen (bands {bands} Hz) takes out none of the peaks in the spectrum of log {log} ({peaks} Hz): its centre is outside where the noise was logged.

command.label: Go here
command.keywords: fly move go to target reposition map guided
command.title: Go here
command.what: The vehicle flies to the place you picked on the map, {distance} m from it and {fromHome} m from home, at {altitude} m above home and {speed} m/s, and stays there. Check that the way is free.
command.altitudeKeywords: altitude height higher lower climb descend guided
command.homeKeywords: home set return rtl here point

reason.params: Guided control needs the complete list of the vehicle's parameters: download it first.
reason.position: The vehicle does not report its position.
reason.air: The vehicle is not in the air.
reason.home: The vehicle has not said where home is lately.
reason.target: Pick a place on the map first.
reason.far: That place is farther from home than your limit in Settings.
reason.unsupported: Guided control is for an ArduPilot vehicle only.
reason.invalid: That place or altitude is not valid.
reason.outOfLimits: That is beyond the limits in Settings or the vehicle's own fence.
reason.notGuided: The vehicle is not in GUIDED.
reason.stalePosition: The vehicle's position is old: try again.
reason.failsafeOff: The vehicle's GCS failsafe (FS_GCS_ENABLE) is off or cannot be read: set it, or choose to be warned in Settings.
reason.fenceUnknown: The vehicle's fence could not be read, so nothing is assumed: download the parameters again first.
reason.landing: The vehicle is returning home or landing: change its mode yourself first.
reason.high: The vehicle is above your highest altitude in Settings.
reason.moving: The vehicle is moving: wait until it has stopped, or try again.
reason.still: The vehicle must stand still to set home: it is moving, climbing or sinking.
reason.keptGuided: The vehicle was put in GUIDED and stays there.
reason.changed: The picked place changed: check it and go again.

settings.title: Guided control
settings.help: Go here on the map. The vehicle must be in the air; the vehicle's own fence is lower still when it limits the numbers below.

labels.failsafe: When the vehicle's GCS failsafe is off

helps.confirmation: A plain confirmation says how far, how high and how fast. A hold is for those who want to be sure.
helps.failsafe: With FS_GCS_ENABLE off the vehicle keeps flying its last command if the link drops. Block refuses the command; Warn sends it and says so.
helps.maxSpeed: No command may ask for more.

panel.title: Place on the map
panel.away: {distance} m from the vehicle, {fromHome} m from home
panel.mode: Go here will switch the vehicle to GUIDED.
panel.speed: Go here sets the speed of GUIDED to {speed} m/s; it stays so if the move is then refused.

altitude.title: Change altitude
altitude.what: The vehicle stops where it is and goes to this altitude above home, and holds there. What it was flying to is cancelled.
altitude.limits: {min} to {max} m (the highest is set in Settings).

problem.invalid: Type a number of metres, for example 20.

home.title: Set home here
home.what: Home moves to where the vehicle is now ({lat}, {lon}). Return home (RTL) flies to this point from now on, and the altitude of home moves with it: every altitude above home changes its reference. Check that it is a place where the vehicle can land.
home.done: Home is set here: Return home now flies to this point.

plan.status: Offline plan: it is not on a vehicle.

addWaypoint.label: Add a waypoint
addWaypoint.keywords: plan mission add new waypoint point item

addOnMap.label: Add waypoints by clicking the map
addOnMap.keywords: plan mission add waypoint map click mode

duplicate.label: Duplicate the item
duplicate.keywords: plan mission copy duplicate clone item

moveUp.label: Move the item up
moveUp.keywords: plan mission move up earlier item

moveDown.label: Move the item down
moveDown.keywords: plan mission move down later item

reason.notOnPlan: Open the Plan page first: this works on the plan that is shown there.
reason.noItemSelected: Select an item of the plan first.
reason.planFull: The plan has 1000 items, the most the page takes.
reason.cannotMove: The item is already at that end of the list.

table.label: Items of the plan, as a table
table.help: Arrows move between cells, Enter goes down a row, Page Up and Page Down go ten rows, Control with Home or End goes to the first or the last row. A cell is a field of the item, the same as in its form; in a choice, Up and Down move between rows: change the option with the mouse, with Space, or with Alt and Down.

map.pinHelp: Drag a pin to move it, or a line between pins to put a waypoint on it. Arrows move between pins, Shift and an arrow move the selected pin (with Ctrl, one pixel), Delete takes it out, Escape drops a drag. Putting a waypoint on a line has no keyboard way: use the list's Add button and the latitude and longitude fields.
map.noPlace: No item has a place yet: give one a latitude and a longitude and it appears on the map.
map.addHelp: Click the map to add a waypoint after the selected item; Escape stops. Without a pointer, use the list's Add button and the latitude and longitude fields.

stats.label: The plan in numbers
stats.note: Distance is the length of the route as drawn through the places that are set, not a flight length. Highest is shown when all altitudes are measured from the same thing.

list.label: Items of the plan
list.emptyHelp: Add a waypoint or another command, then give it a place.

detail.empty: Select an item to edit it.
detail.title: Item {number}: {name}
detail.hereHint: Leave the place empty to use where the vehicle is when it gets here.
detail.placeNeeded: A place is needed: without one the vehicle uses where it is.

problem.label: What is wrong with the plan
problem.tooMany: The plan has more than {max} items.
problem.overVehicle: The vehicle takes {max} items at the most: the plan has more.
problem.noTakeoff: The first item that flies is not a takeoff: the vehicle must already be flying when the mission starts.
problem.atZero: The place is 0, 0: the vehicle takes it for where the item before it is.
problem.zeroAltitude: An altitude of 0 above home: the vehicle takes it for the altitude of the item before it.
problem.altHigh: The altitude is more than {max} m.
problem.takeoffAltitude: A takeoff needs an altitude above 0.
problem.offGlobe: The place is off the globe.
problem.jumpTarget: The jump needs the number of an item of the plan.
